tt-insights.dataDelay: follower_count, following_count, likes_count and video_count are lifetime counters whose time series come from Zernio daily snapshots. video_views, likes, comments, shares and profile_views are TikTok's own daily account figures: the latest day available is yesterday and TikTok can take 24-48 hours to settle a day. Watch time, impression sources and account-level reach/impressions are not available on this endpoint.

fb-insights.dataDelay: Meta page insights may be delayed up to 24 hours. Metrics reflect the current (post-November 2025) Graph API names. Monetization earnings are approximate and Meta restates them after the fact.
